# RFC / technical proposal recipe (summary)

Full recipe: `docs/ARTIFACT_RECIPES.md` (canonical).

Composed `ASSESS + SPECIFY`.

```text
ASSESS:  problem · evidence · current constraints · considered alternatives
         · decision basis
SPECIFY: selected target · scope · non-goals · requirements · compatibility
         · migration · evidence required for acceptance
         · reversal/update conditions
```

Rules: non-goals are first-class; compatibility and migration are explicit;
reversal/update conditions are requirements, not footnotes.
